invariants.rationale: The method calls data.stream(), which would throw if data is null.
Method passes consumer (via throwingForeachWrapper) to forEach—consumer must be non-null to avoid NPE.
For a non-null List, stream() always returns a non-null Stream instance.
A parallelism parameter less than 1 is likely disallowed for meaningful parallel or sequential execution.
Stream over a List yields each element once; count() matches size().
